accepted_chain.binary_archives: Already durable batch.tar.gz files remain at the remote proof-object root; local cleanup does not remove the remote authoritative archive.
include_ledger_metadata: Each PREPARED.json and independently verified DURABLE_BATCH.json
Exact prior-durable hashes and cumulative accepted map
Actual arrival/verification/cleanup receipts and original transport logs
accepted_chain.separation: Supplemental evidence never uses PREPARED_NOT_DURABLE accepted-batch schema or masquerades as accepted compilation.

exclude_rules: Do not recursively rearchive build/artifacts: the accepted checkpoint chain owns every accepted artifact bundle.
Do not read active attempt outputs as if terminal. Do not delete or mutate attempt/build/source/runtime files.
include_rules: All original invocation START.json, RESUME_VALIDATION.json if generated, SUMMARY.json, including every failed/controlled-stop invocation.

All attempt receipt.json and compiler.log originals. Accepted attempts may be linked to exact accepted checkpoint batch records; unaccepted attempts and partial stage/superseded artifact bytes must be retained separately, never treated as accepted.
Capture top-level mutable SUMMARY only as a uniquely named terminal snapshot; retain source path, capture time and original SHA.
Capture exact selected launch invocation, matching resource hints and control bytes, original root launch/review and observer invocation/script; link before/after control snapshots when they exist.
Original raw tool-return JSON, including truncation metadata, and original resource/OOM samples. Missing prior raw driver chunks are explicitly reported as missing, never reconstructed.
capture_batches.label: build-terminal-NNN
capture_batches.when: After a particular invocation has terminated and all its workers have drained; preserve each failed or controlled-stop invocation immediately, not only the final success.

additional_originals: Actual launch prerequisite record, actual terminal tool observations and optional resource-observer outputs, actual freeze/dry-run return records, audit/helper/harness references by durable exact SHA.
All failed audit attempts in their separate output directories, if any; never overwrite or omit a failure in favor of a later success.
Every byte of each large INPUT_FREEZE/RECOVERY_FREEZE body must be preserved; summaries alone are insufficient.
capture_batches.label: audit-and-freeze-before-fresh-NNN
capture_batches.launch_condition: Root verifies all accepted artifact batches are durably confirmed and this complete pre-fresh evidence batch is remotely hash-verified; archival status itself is not a proof gate.
capture_batches.when: After full4406 build and exact118/broad audits have actually terminated and official final freeze has been generated; before a long official fresh run.

additional_originals: Exact actual execute invocation and raw terminal tool-return JSON, pre/post resource samples, final peer reviews if created.

If interruption prevented a file from being generated, retain the existing RUNNING/partial files and actual interruption exit with an explicit missing-file list; never synthesize a successful terminal result.
capture_batches.label: fresh-terminal-NNN
capture_batches.optional_during_run: Only root-authorized immutable log-prefix snapshots with exact byte length/hash and explicit PARTIAL_NOT_TERMINAL status; never present a prefix as a complete checker log.
capture_batches.when: After the official checker and supervisor have terminated, whichever result occurred.

capture_safety: Use an explicit original-file inventory with regular-file/no-symlink checks, unique absent destination, and pre/post source stat+SHA checks. Stop if a supposedly terminal input changes.
Record all paths, byte lengths and SHA256 values. Losslessly reconstruct and verify split originals at destination before recording REMOTE_BYTES_VERIFIED.
Preserve original bytes; no JSON reserialization of evidence. Inventory policy and split metadata are new records, clearly identified.
No Lean/checker/Git/source/runtime mutation is performed by evidence capture. No existing remote file is overwritten.
Every unexpected file in the named terminal evidence/attempt directories is reported for explicit inclusion or reasoned exclusion; no silent deletion.
future_paths: New retry/control/observer paths are added by explicit selected launch records, not guessed or silently collected from unrelated directories.
